JUST ARRIVED.........FINANCE AVAILABLE - Yet another great example from Smithfield Motors. Recent service carried out. Please call or email for further information. Viewing is also available after hours in our showroom. This 2019 Porsche Panamera boasts a clean vehicle history check, offering you peace of mind. This Panamera 4 is the V6 E-Hybrid variant, with a 2.9L Petrol Plug-in Hybrid engine and a four-wheel-drive system. The vehicle is also equipped with several desirable features, including 21in Alloy Wheels with an Exclusive Design painted in Black High-Gloss, and black sports tailpipes. The BOSE Surround Sound System, including premium branded speakers, provides an immersive audio experience. Automatic headlight activation, including Welcome Home lighting, and LED main headlights enhance visibility and safety. The Panamera's ability to accelerate from 0-62mph in just 4.6 seconds demonstrates its impressive performance capabilities. Compliant with Euro 6 emission standards, this vehicle represents a blend of performance and environmental consciousness. The trim level 4 indicates a focus on luxury and advanced features.
